description: Return a string of the code points passed, in order. A code point must be from 0 to 0x10FFFF and not a surrogate (U+D800 to U+DFFF): a string can not hold a lone surrogate. The result is NFC, like every string.

errorsThrown.reason: a code point is negative, above 0x10FFFF, or a surrogate

returns.description: The string of those code points.
